note: The contract between the plugin and the resource pack. The plugin emits these codepoints; the pack draws them. Nothing here is a visual decision: it assigns identities and sizes, not appearances.

status.purpose: Status and stack icons shown beside a readout.

ability.purpose: Ability slots. Count follows the harness class inputs: A1, A2, ultimate.

panel.purpose: Background panel pieces for a bossbar title strip.

infrastructure.purpose: The four recognized forms plus the Level 6 alternative.

hunger.purpose: Hunger readout. The vanilla row is hidden by this pack because a static texture cannot tell an empty drumstick a player could refill from one their Capacity does not grant. Three states are therefore drawn here, plus a half step.

hidden_vanilla_sprites.purpose: Vanilla HUD sprites this pack replaces with fully transparent images, so the plugin can draw the readout itself.
